About the author

Peter Watson is an entrepreneur, investor, author, and U.S. Marine Corps veteran whose work focuses on business, investing, leadership, and personal development. He is the founder of King Global Consulting Inc. and the founder of Watson Capital, a hedge fund focused on investment opportunities across public markets. Peter has built and developed ventures across financial services, technology, and consulting. Through his companies and mentorship work, Peter has worked with entrepreneurs and professionals seeking to improve their decision-making, financial knowledge, leadership, and ability to execute at a higher level. His writing combines real-world business experience with the principles of discipline, strategy, accountability, and long-term thinking. Rather than focusing solely on theory, Peter writes about frameworks that can be applied to business, wealth creation, investing, leadership, and everyday decision-making.
